author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Standing angel with a large scalloped wing behind the shoulder and an arm reaching toward a small kneeling figure (head resting on a rounded back, shins along the ground); reads as the annunciation scene.
omissions: Angel drawn with the set's stick construction and a shortened arm (keeps 8 from the kneeler's head); the kneeler is simplified to a rounded bowed back with folded shins.
